messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man walks slowly forward toward the camera, then stops and turns his head to look up and to his left.","camera":"A full-body shot that gradually tightens to a medium close-up as the man approaches, with the camera remaining at a low, frontal angle.","clothing":"He wears a red-and-black checkered three-piece suit with a white shirt, black tie, and black-and-white sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair cropped close to the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered man with a short beard and dark skin stands facing the camera.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic interior with a glossy reflective floor, a large glass dome ceiling, and glowing pink and teal neon rings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's arm-raising dance with a slow forward walk toward the camera, followed by stopping and turning his head upward and to the side, matching the reference motion. The man's red checkered suit, futuristic dome scene, neon lighting, and frontal framing are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the man's current dancing action with the motion shown in the reference: standing, walking slowly forward, stopping, and looking up/around, while preserving his identity, suit, scene, lighting, and camera setup.
uncertain: Whether the head-turn direction and timing exactly match the reference motion.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing tightens from full body to medium close-up as the man approaches, which is consistent with the reference motion but changes the original framing over time.
